Payouts and earnings

You decide which transactions are earnings, tips, expenses, platform fees and settlements. A payout can settle several earnings, and an earning can be paid in parts. Review the gross amount, fees, net cash and unpaid balance before confirming a match. Recording a deposit as new earnings as well as a payout can overstate income. A balanced match records your allocation and does not confirm that a platform or bank paid the correct amount.

Imports and tax records

Check CSV mappings, dates, signs and possible duplicates before importing. Reconcile your book against platform statements, deposit records, receipts and tax forms. The app does not retrieve a platform’s official ledger, move funds, determine deductibility or file returns. You are responsible for the records you rely on, tax decisions and filing deadlines. The publisher provides no individual accounting or tax advice.

Your vault and exports

Your browser stores the encrypted book on this device. Keep the password and a separate, tested .cqvault backup. Restore only after reviewing the preview and saving the current book. A backup preserves the book and its reconciliation history. A CSV exposes readable amounts, notes and references and may contain only the rows selected for export. Take care when sending it to a tax preparer or storing it on a shared device.

Use of records and software

You keep whatever rights you have in your records and exports. Enter, import and share only material you are authorized to handle. Use the software lawfully. Do not falsify records, use another person’s credentials without permission, or interfere with others’ access. Do not send private records to a public project channel.
